caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with visible creases and a border design. The fabric has a light beige or off-white background. The border consists of an embroidered pattern that runs along all four sides, featuring green and blue birds, red flowers with yellow centers, green leaves, and curling blue stems. The top edge of the fabric shows some damage with frayed and torn sections. In the upper central area, there is an embroidered basket (colored in yellow with green shading) containing dark blue and green leaves and four red flowers. In the lower center, there is a colorful bird perched on a light brown branch with green leaves. The bird has a yellow head, pink underparts, green and pink wings, blue and green tail feathers, and a black beak. The arrangement is symmetrical along the borders with repeating motifs of birds, flowers, and leaves. The embroidery uses predominantly red, green, blue, pink, and yellow thread on a plain, light-colored background.
title: Crewel Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
